key.name: touch-mode
key.description: A taller top bar, a larger dock, roomier menus and Today from the right edge. follow is on while the computer is folded into a tablet (its hinge's tablet switch), on is always, off is never.

key.name: pen-ring
key.description: What the pen's side button opens: six tools around the pen's tip (ring), or in a column at the screen's edge (strip). off turns them and their shortcut off.

key.name: pen-ring-tools
key.description: From the top, clockwise: scribble, area, note, text, right-click and back, each once.

key.name: pen-ring-key
key.description: Bound only while the pen's tools are on; the pen's side button sends it once ame desktop touch pen-button has set the pen up.
